description: This PHP class defines the entity 'LeaveRequest' for an HR management system, representing a leave request made by an employee. It includes properties such as leave type, date applied, employee details, and associated leaves, with ORM annotations for database mapping.

classes.name: LeaveRequest
classes.description: Represents a leave request record associated with an employee, including details like leave type, application date, and associated leave entries, with ORM entity configuration.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the leave request.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier of the leave request.

methods.name: getLeaveType
methods.description: Retrieves the leave type associated with this request.

methods.name: setLeaveType
methods.description: Sets the leave type for this leave request.

methods.name: getDateApplied
methods.description: Returns the date when the leave request was applied.

methods.name: setDateApplied
methods.description: Sets the date when the leave request was applied.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves the employee who made the leave request.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an employee with this leave request.

methods.name: getLeaves
methods.description: Returns the collection of leave entries linked to this request.

methods.name: setLeaves
methods.description: Sets the collection of leave entries for this request.
